## Required result

1. One compact action-result surface below the prompt, independent of danger and central alerts. Use `summary ?? message`, full untruncated refusals, no arbitrary character limit/clamp. Success2.5s/refusal4s active-time trial lifetimes; pause does not consume them. Clear without replay on menu/panel/session reset, relevant actor/refuge changes and opening. Panels keep full-message local feedback. Preserve repeated identical action accessibility; cancel/version asynchronous announcements on replacement/reset/disposal. Persistence save-retry/error and graphics surfaces remain usable outside hidden HUD ancestors.
2. Consume shared reachPreview separately from aimedInteraction. No key/action at preview range; generic Move closer for null label, known name only when provided. Executable target wins. Improve bracket contrast with a light core/dark edge; preview is visibly quieter. Retain depth testing/fog/LOS, bounded geometry/material lifecycle and no wall-visible markers or interaction change. No broad scene/material/art work.
3. Build typed hazard contexts from the same current-state banner calculation that actually renders. Deduplicate a hazard notice only when that current matching banner covers it, never using stale previous-frame contexts or string matching. Preserve recovery, Calls fading, persistence and pulse availability/cost. Announce newly appearing contexts without per-percent live-region chatter. Suppress redundant bottom guidance during a threat. Call indicator is explicitly a horizontal-bearing dial with a separate elevation marker and concise accessible wording; preserve detached emission origin, lifetime and resets. Do not represent it as a projected screen arrow.
4. Piloted Dart service discoverability uses serviceState/serviceRefusal even when fully serviced; useful compact Service here · Tab or Patch hull first where authoritative. Accumulate S1 thrust-sample only for requested>1e−5, actual≤10% requested, measured solid loss≥80% lost travel for0.5 active seconds. Missing sample/progress/release/boundary/pause/actor/session resets. Existing ascent warning wins. Generic Blocked ahead; rail-centering help only if actual current position/context justifies it. No zero-speed inference, docking or geometry/handling edits.
5. Layout prompt/result/look and warnings/call/compass/toolbar without overlap at960×600 and1280×800. Actionable secondary text **and keys ≥12px**;11px only non-action uppercase labels. Keep stable toolbar and persistent capture/fallback affordance, one contextual hint, deliberate resume and keyboard focus. Rename outer Hold labels to Cargo, hide empty opening detail and inaccurate in-session pause subtitle. Keep narrative captions, controls/settings/save information and truthful unfinished-campaign label. No auto-fade, Escape-resume or developer-menu redesign.
